# The command cases of cb_exe_gate (native/cb/app/exe_gate_main.cpp, run by tools\gate.cmd): codebreaker.exe is run on each line and
# its exit code, stdout and the files it leaves in {out} are compared with testdata/exe_gate/golden/<name>.txt. Every command of the
# table in codebreaker/__main__.py has two to four cases here (usage, a real run, an error); `ui` and `boot-floppy` are the exceptions:
# `ui` is the interactive terminal (its smoke is a terminal test, not a command line), and `boot-floppy` rebuilds the whole Setup floppy
# (80 s). Goldens were recorded from the exe that ran the translated Python for the commands not yet native (2026-11-13), then each
# command's output was read: where a native command differs from the Python only in wording, the golden is re-recorded after review
# (`tools\gate.cmd --update --filter NAME`), and that diff is what a reviewer reads.
#
# Inputs are small real files kept in the repository (native/cb/*/testdata, tests/fixtures, testdata/exe_gate/in) and, for what only
# exists on the owner's machine, the Win95 corpus (@needs=corpus) and the Xbox 360 games folder (@needs=games: skipped when absent).
fmt = {repo}/native/cb/formats/testdata
td = {repo}/testdata/exe_gate/in

# --- what a file is: info, names, identify, decompile, analyze -------------------------------------------------------------------
info-pe: info {fmt}/lz32.dll
info-ne: info {fmt}/lzexpand.dll
info-le: info {fmt}/bios.vxd
info-dos-exe: info {fmt}/setver.exe
info-dos-com: info {fmt}/choice.com
info-obj: info {fmt}/fastadd.obj
info-xex: info {games}/RubyDung/RubyDung.xex @needs=games
info-missing: info {work}/no_such_file.dll
info-corpus-name: info lz32.dll @needs=corpus
names-pe: names {fmt}/lz32.dll
names-ne: names {fmt}/lzexpand.dll
names-usage: names
identify-pe: identify {fmt}/lz32.dll
identify-ne: identify {fmt}/lzexpand.dll
identify-dos: identify {fmt}/setver.exe
demangle-function: demangle "?foo@@YAXH@Z"
demangle-method: demangle "?Run@Widget@@QAEHPBDH@Z"
demangle-plain: demangle plain_name
decompile-pe: decompile {fmt}/lz32.dll --out {out}/lz32.c
decompile-ne: decompile {fmt}/lzexpand.dll --out {out}/lzexpand.c
decompile-missing: decompile {work}/no_such_file.dll
analyze-pe: analyze {fmt}/lz32.dll @mask="\d+\.\d+s"
analyze-strings: analyze {fmt}/lz32.dll --what strings,conventions @mask="\d+\.\d+s"
analyze-ne: analyze {fmt}/lzexpand.dll @mask="\d+\.\d+s"
origin-ne: origin {fmt}/lzexpand.dll
origin-list: origin {fmt}/lzexpand.dll --list
dos-functions-com: dos-functions {fmt}/choice.com
dos-functions-exe: dos-functions {fmt}/setver.exe
dos-interrupts-service: dos-interrupts 21 3d
dos-interrupts-int: dos-interrupts 10
dos-interrupts-unknown: dos-interrupts 99
driver-services-vxd: driver-services {fmt}/bios.vxd
driver-services-small: driver-services {fmt}/splitter.vxd {fmt}/srammtd.vxd
classes-xex: classes {games}/RubyDung/RubyDung.xex @needs=games
resources-ne: resources {fmt}/lzexpand.dll --out {out}
resources-pe: resources {fmt}/charmap.exe --out {out}
coverage-all: coverage @head=3 @mask="(32-bit|16-bit) [0-9a-f]{12}"
coverage-module: coverage --module lz32.dll @needs=corpus
reach-file: reach {fmt}/lz32.dll
reach-folder: reach {fmt}/cab
corpus-executables: corpus-executables @needs=corpus @head=40

recompile-project-usage: recompile-project
xenon-recompile-missing: xenon-recompile {work}/no_such.toml

# --- sources: the assembly the program writes and builds back -------------------------------------------------------------------
